title: Command palette (⌘K)
brief: The Ctrl/Cmd+K dialog stops searching chats and becomes the only place slash commands run; the composer loses `/` typing. Three structural directions over a quiet workspace context: centred spotlight, composer-anchored sheet, docked panel.

artboards.title: Spotlight overlay
artboards.tradeoff: Maximum focus and speed; hides the conversation while it is open

artboards.title: Composer sheet
artboards.tradeoff: The conversation stays visible and the detail column has room; the sheet competes with the thread for vertical space

artboards.title: Docked panel
artboards.tradeoff: Nothing covers the conversation and discovery is easy; it costs the inspector and is slower for a keyboard-only user
